featured_reviews.name: Indrakumar Muddiah
featured_reviews.review_text: If you have anything to donate to orphanage like clothes or toys, this is the place to do so. It also has all lighting and decorative materials to decorate your home for Christmas, including Christmas tree of various sizes at a very reasonable rate. Also saw different sizes of statues for making crib for indoors and outdoors. Ample parking space inside. One place for all Christmas decorations. Will be visiting soon again.

featured_reviews.name: Atine De
featured_reviews.review_text: A religious center of the Roman catholic community attached to the Archdiocese of Vasai. They mainly cater to the needs of the local catholic community of the vasai diocese whose local spoken language is marathi. Hence all the religious books, hymnals etc are here printed in marathi language. Not much parking space is available. The attendants here are cooperative and helpful. It has a peaceful and serene atmosphere. During advent Christmas articles like decorations, cards, lightings, stars, etc are made available here and sold at reasonable prices. Conversing in marathi is an advantage here.
